title: Lab import can follow a swapped ancestor outside the selected project
description: A deterministic unsandboxed importer test read dummy bytes from a sibling directory after a writable ancestor was replaced by a symlink between enumeration and open. The shipped macOS app's effective sandbox access to that sibling has not been demonstrated, so private-data disclosure through the signed release remains unverified.
claimed_root_cause: The original importer rejected symlinks while enumerating but reopened each full path later with O_NOFOLLOW only on the final component.

trace.description: The app imports the user-selected directory into site source files.
The original enumeration checked a file URL's symlink status before a later read.
The original full-path open followed a replaced parent symlink while O_NOFOLLOW protected only the leaf.

evidence.description: The patched-tree regression fixture swaps dist/assets for a symlink to a sibling containing dummy-private-data; the original importer read the sibling bytes and the repaired importer rejects the read.

blockers: The effective signed-app sandbox and security-scoped bookmark behavior were not exercised with the ancestor-swap fixture.
No protected sibling read or unintended publication was demonstrated in the signed release.

validation_plan.local: Run the same dummy ancestor-swap import inside a development-signed Lab app with its release-equivalent App Sandbox entitlements and a user-selected directory; inspect whether the sibling is readable and whether an imported draft contains those bytes.
validation_plan.deployment: Verify the final signed release entitlements and repeat only with disposable files under an authorized test account before asserting a release disclosure path.
